title: Korea has a season for making and sharing kimchi
body: Kimjang takes place in late autumn in South Korea. Families and neighbours work together to prepare and share large batches of kimchi, the seasoned fermented vegetables eaten through the winter.
takeaway: Sharing the work helps households prepare a winter supply and passes the techniques to new makers.
visual: a close view of hands seasoning napa cabbage over a large earthenware bowl
